Security and Compliance Requirements 3 The shipment and transaction data gene rated by the Government contains the Personally Identifiable Information (P II) and official movement orders—both classified as Controlled Unclassified Info rmation (CUI)—of the Service member or DoW civilian, all TSP information technology (IT) systems proces sing, storing, or transmitting this data are strictly regul ated. To host the central Government API connection, the TSP's IT system must achieve and maintain a Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 (Adva nced) Self-Assessment in accordance with NIST SP 800-171 standards for protecting CUI on non-Federal systems, which mandates robust access controls, active incident response protocols, and strict data encryption both at rest and in transit. deliverables_scope.text: ect household goods (HHG) moving, shipping, transportation, and storage service providers. Accordingly, the PPA invites industry partners and service providers to submit detailed information regarding integrati on costs, associated software development timelines, standard industry practices, and recommendations for test ing and risk mitigation when connecting their internal software systems to a central Government platform. This Request for Information (RFI) enables industry stakeholders to provide direct feedback on how this type of integration will impact their current systems and operations, helping to shape future technical requirements and acquisition decisions. This RFI is issued solely for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation for proposals. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot form a binding contract. The PPA is not under any obligation to pursue any acquisition alternative based on this RFI, and the Government will not compensate respondents fo r any information received. All submissions will be kept confidential, will become the property of the U.S. Government, and will not be returned. II.
